title: Tissue-specific gene expression in mouse founder strains
bodyHtml:
Page description

Use this interface to explore tissue-specific and sex-specific gene expression levels and differential gene expression across the eight founder strains of the collaborative cross and diversity outbred mouse populations. See the Research Method tab for more details about the analysis.

  • Start by selecting a tissue and entering a gene name, then click Search.
  • Click on any column header to sort a table by that column.
  • Use the filters to filter the content of both tables and plots.

Most expressed genes in a tissue (P-value <= 0.05)

The p-values shown reflect the significance of differential expression of the listed genes in the selected tissue across sex, across the 8 founder strains, or across combined strain and sex. Only p-values ≤ 0.5 are shown.

 

Gene expression across tissues

The p-values shown reflect the significance of differential expression of the selected gene in the tissues studied, across sex, across the 8 founder strains, or across combined strain and sex. Only p-values ≤ 0.5 are shown.

 

Gene expression on selected tissue by founders and sex

Gene expression levels (log2 normalized) of the selected gene in the selected tissue are shown for each founder strain and each sex. Click the tabs to view plots of the data grouped by strain or by sex. Blue bars in the table reflect the percentage of the maximum value.

 

HuGE

Phenotype associations of the human ortholog of the selected mouse gene, generated by the Human Genetic Evidence (HuGE) Calculator, which combines common-variant and rare-variant genetic associations to produce a score reflecting the likelihood that the gene has a role in a disease or trait. Orange horizontal lines across the plot represent HuGE scores of Moderate evidence (HuGE score = 3, lower line) and Very strong evidence (HuGE score = 30, upper line). Blue bars in the table reflect the percentage of the maximum value. 

 

common_variant

Gene-level associations of the human ortholog of the selected mouse gene, calculated from bottom-line meta-analyzed common variant genetic associations using the MAGMA algorithm. Blue bars in the table reflect the percentage of the maximum value.

 

rare_variant

Gene-level associations of the human ortholog of the selected mouse gene, calculated from rare variant associations. See this page for a description of the source datasets.
